req_desc:
Run manifest and health check
Ship /app/run.json and serve the app on port 4173 with GET /api/health answering as stated in Deployment.

Credentials from the environment
Read every service URL, credential and clock setting from the environment variables listed in Configuration and secrets, never hard-code them and never send them to the browser.

Accounts, roles and sessions
Let practitioners and clinics create accounts and everyone sign in with email and password, and gate each staff action to its one role as stated in Business rules.

One error shape and order
Answer every API error with the one JSON error shape and the single precedence order stated in API.

Same-origin server boundary
Enforce the request limits, origin check and never-served paths stated in Server boundary.

Nocturnal palette with curing-blue states
Set the site on a near-black umber ground with bone text, using curing-light blue only for live and selected states and gold only for Atelier marks.

Chaptered editorial composition
Give each of the seven chapters a full viewport with oversized split serif headlines and chapter navigation as Screens and layout gives for each viewport, with headlines across the left two thirds and a numbered chapter rail on the right edge at 1280x800.

Clinical tabular numerals
Set every number (prices, countdowns, seat counts, bench labels, session minutes) in tabular figures from a small fixed set of sizes.

Explore the seven chapters
A visitor scrolls from overture to reserve, switches agenda days, opens an evening's details and an FAQ answer, and reaches the bench map at every published viewport.

Content desk writes to PocketBase
Let the event director create, edit and delete agenda sessions, hospitality events, hotels and FAQ entries in the PocketBase collections named in Services, with agenda writes checked against the hands-on share rule one at a time as stated in Business rules.

Public content reads live
Show PocketBase content on the public site and in the public content API on the next load after any change, with no restart.

Hospitality tier gating
Show Atelier-only evenings to everyone as gated, and reveal their time, venue and description only to the accounts stated in Business rules.

Published layouts at three viewports
Render the agenda, hospitality list, bench map and reserve bar in the arrangement Screens and layout gives for 375x812, 768x1024 and 1280x800, with no sideways scrolling.

Collapsed panels are inert
Keep a closed chapter drawer, a collapsed FAQ answer and collapsed evening details hidden, unfocusable and out of the accessibility tree until opened.

Lab scene orbit by drag and touch
Render the procedural lab scene and orbit it by mouse or touch drag inside the published range, springing back inside it on release.

Scroll-driven lab camera and preloader
Move the lab camera from overhead plan to bench height as the lab chapter scrolls, reversing on scroll back, after a preloader that counts to 100 as stated in Motion and effects.

Reduced-motion bench plan
Under reduced motion or without WebGL, replace the scene with the flat labelled bench plan that keeps hold, release, waitlist and checkout and runs no orbit, lift, spring, scrub or kinetic letters.

Bench inventory and seats remaining
Publish the 24 benches with per-viewer states computed for each request and the seat counts from the one ledger computation in Business rules, agreeing on every surface and refreshed on screen within two seconds of any change.

Server-timed holds
Hold a bench for the server's hold length from server creation, never extended by client activity, and show its countdown and end from the server's status whatever the device clock says.

Keyboard bench map
Let a practitioner move across benches with arrow keys, hold with Enter and release with Escape, with no pointer.

Bench Lift on the server's answer
Lift the held bench on a spring, split its label into moving letters and deplete a ring in step with the server's hold time, starting only once the server accepts the hold as stated in Motion and effects.

Announced bench outcomes
Show the pending hold text and announce each hold, loss, release, expiry, payment result and seat count in the Bench updates live region with the copy from Feedback states.

Hold a bench from the map
A signed-in practitioner picks an open bench, sees it held with a running countdown, and releases it or lets it end, with the bench returning to open.

Atelier rows and hard cap
Allow only Atelier reservations on rows A and B and never let active Atelier reservations, live offers included, exceed the cap in Business rules.

One winner for the last bench
When simultaneous holds race for the same bench or the last Atelier place, exactly one succeeds and every other gets the conflict code and waitlist offer stated in Business rules.

Atelier sold-out copy
Show the Atelier sold-out heading, banner and bench labels from Feedback states once the cap is reached, live offers included, even while row A or B benches are open.

Pay a deposit by keyboard
A practitioner holding a bench opens checkout, pays the deposit using only the keyboard and sees the confirmation heading, with focus returned to the opener on Close or Escape and to the hold panel heading after Done.

One Kill Bill charge per payment
Record each deposit, balance, full payment, upgrade and refund in Kill Bill exactly once however often it is retried, with replay and conflict answers as stated in Business rules.

Paid only after Kill Bill, receipt and mail
Move a reservation to a paid state only after Kill Bill confirms the payment, the receipt PDF is stored and the receipt email is queued; otherwise show it as pending, as qualified in Business rules.

Confirmation outlasts the hold timer
Keep the confirmation of a payment sent before the hold ended on screen after the countdown reaches zero, and never let a later repaint replace it or an outage message.

Balance payment to paid in full
Let the buyer pay the outstanding balance once the deposit is paid, moving the reservation to paid in full with its receipt and email.

Balance reminders at 21 and 7 days
Email each buyer still owing a balance the 21-day and 7-day reminders at most once each across every app process sharing the database, on the venue-local dates in Business rules.

Reserve-by deadline
Refuse new deposits from venue-local 20 March 2027 while still selling full-payment seats, publish deposits_open and hide the Pay deposit button when it is false, as stated in Business rules.

Atelier upgrade difference
Move a paid seat to an open Atelier bench and invoice only the price difference, split by the seat's state and the venue-local date as stated in Business rules.

Tier waitlists
Let a signed-in buyer join the waitlist for a tier with no bench to hold and show their position, as stated in Business rules.

Waitlist offers on server time
Offer each freed bench to the first waitlisted buyer for its tier for the server's offer window, email them, and pass a lapsed or declined offer to the next.

Hold-ended dialog
Show the hold-ended dialog with its published copy only after the server reports the hold released.

Accept a waitlist offer
A waitlisted practitioner gets the offer email, signs in, accepts the bench within the window and holds it with a fresh countdown.

Buyer cancellation frees the bench
Let the buyer cancel a paid seat up to the refund cut-off, freeing the bench for the waitlist and fixing the refund due, as stated in Business rules.

Dated refund schedule
Compute the refund due in integer cents from the venue-local date of the cancel request and the amount paid under the schedule in Business rules.

Registrar refund through Kill Bill
Let only the registrar send a cancelled seat's refund to Kill Bill, split across its payments newest first as stated in Business rules, and mark it refunded only after Kill Bill confirms every part.

Registrar reconciles and refunds
The registrar opens the desk, sees each reservation's paid and refunded amounts as Kill Bill records them, issues a refund and sees the row turn refunded.

Buy seats on one clinic account
A clinic buyer holds several benches together, pays one group invoice in full, optionally naming colleagues, and sees the group confirmation.

One group invoice, one item per seat
Bill a group checkout as one Kill Bill invoice with one item per seat whose amounts sum to the invoice total.

Group invoice confirmation heading
Show the group confirmation heading from Feedback states after a group payment is confirmed.

Group emails list names and benches only
Send group receipts and group refund emails that list each seat's bench and colleague name and never a licence number, passport detail or uploaded file.

Assign and reassign a seat
Let the buyer name or change the attendee of any of their paid seats until day 1 check-in, email the new colleague, and cut off the former assignee at once as stated in Business rules.

Each person sees only their own records
Show each colleague only their own seat, documents and certificate, and show the buying clinic seat status without licence or passport files, answering 404 for anything else.

Colleague accepts a seat
An assigned colleague signs up with the invited email, accepts the seat, uploads a licence and sees only their seat.

Cancel one group seat
Cancel and refund one group seat under the dated schedule, adjusting only that seat's invoice item so the items still sum to the invoice.

Upgrade one group seat
Upgrade one group seat on its own upgrade invoice without changing the group invoice or the other seats.

Safe document uploads
Accept licence and passport scans only as PDF, JPEG or PNG judged by content, within the size limit in API, stored privately in MinIO and fetched through short-lived signed links.

Registrar licence review
Let only the registrar mark an attendee's licence matched or rejected, as stated in Business rules.

Visa-support letters
Let the registrar issue a visa-support letter PDF once for an attendee with a passport scan and email them, recording nothing and sending nothing when storage fails.

Check-in on the venue date
Let front-desk staff check a paid-in-full attendee in for each course day only on that day's venue-local date in America/Chicago, as stated in Business rules.

Keyboard check-in desk
Let front-desk staff search by name and check an attendee in using only the keyboard, with the matches and announcements always for the latest search text.

CE certificate issued once
Issue the PACE-format certificate PDF only for an eligible attendee, generate it once with a gapless certificate number, re-serve the same object and email the attendee.

Kill Bill outage and recovery
While Kill Bill is unreachable, answer payment, refund and desk requests as stated in Services with the published copy, and resume when it returns without a restart.

Storage and mail outage recovery
While MinIO or Mailpit is unreachable, keep payments pending and mail queued as stated in Services, and finish them when the service returns without a restart.

Live hands-on share
Recompute the content desk's projected hands-on share and its 30% field error in place on every keystroke before saving, as stated in Interactions and Feedback states.
/app/run.json has exactly the keys _schema (value run-manifest-v1), install, build and serve, all strings.
/app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md names every shipped package and both bundled fonts, each with its licence; shipped packages means the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json.
Shipped packages (the same production dependency tree) and bundled fonts use only the MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, 0BSD or OFL-1.1 licences.
There is no datastore beyond Postgres, MinIO and PocketBase: no SQLite, no Redis, no in-memory store of record and no state files on local disk.
The provided service configuration is left unchanged: the compose files, and the dev tenant, bucket, database and PocketBase admin settings.
The built site loads no script, stylesheet, font or image from another origin.
A committed package-lock.json matches package.json.
